answer_1.quote: This paper tackles the problem of decoding nonstandardized informal romanization used in social media into the original orthography without parallel text.
answer_1.outputs: decoded original script sequences from romanized text

answer_2.quote: We use character error rate (CER) as our evaluation metric. We compute CER as the ratio of the character-level edit distance between the predicted original script sequence and the human annotation to the length of the annotation sequence in characters.

answer_4.quote: Each sentence in the validation and test sets is annotated by one of the two native speaker annotators, following guidelines similar to those designed for the Arabizi BOLT data.
answer_4.guideline: guidelines similar to those designed for the Arabizi BOLT data
